title: Report import migrations and incompatibilities
description: Return stable actionable ImportPlan findings for migrations, duplicate identities, missing/corrupt assets, future versions, incompatible records, and referential-integrity failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Every required finding class has a stable machine-readable code, severity, affected identity/type, and next action
Unsupported future bundle or record versions are blocking and never silently dropped
Duplicate IDs, missing/corrupt assets, incompatible records, and broken references identify all affected records in deterministic order
Applied in-memory migrations list source version, target version, and result without claiming commit
The report is understandable without color and associates errors with affected records

steps.details: Add canonical ImportFinding codes/severities and migration report entries for every PRD-listed failure and warning class.
Extend import planning to collect deterministic findings across all registered types rather than stopping at the first record error when safe.
Display grouped semantic lists with record/type identifiers, migration paths, blocking state, and safe next actions.
Cover every finding class, combinations, canonical ordering, future refusal, no silent salvage, keyboard navigation, and accessible associations.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; add the required finding taxonomy to the existing import planner and report.
Do not echo private record contents unnecessarily in reports; identities and concise paths are sufficient.
Warnings may permit commit only when the explicit import policy says they are non-destructive.
